title: Simple Pancakes
text:
Pancakes are easy to make. You need flour, eggs, milk, and a little sugar. First, put the flour and sugar in a big bowl. Then add the eggs and milk and mix well.

Next, heat a pan with a little oil. Pour a small amount of the mixture into the pan. Cook the pancake for two minutes, then turn it over. Your pancakes are ready to eat!

questions.text: What do you need to make pancakes?
How long do you cook the pancake before you turn it over?
Why do you put a little oil in the pan?
options: So the pancake does not stick to the pan
So the pancake becomes very sweet
So the pancake gets bigger in the bowl

questions.text: Who is this text probably written for?
options: Someone who wants to learn how to cook
Someone who wants to buy a new pan
Someone who wants to become a doctor

paragraph_translations: Panquecas são fáceis de fazer. Você precisa de farinha, ovos, leite e um pouco de açúcar. Primeiro, coloque a farinha e o açúcar em uma tigela grande. Depois, adicione os ovos e o leite e misture bem.

Em seguida, aqueça uma frigideira com um pouco de óleo. Despeje uma pequena quantidade da mistura na frigideira. Cozinhe a panqueca por dois minutos e depois vire-a. Suas panquecas estão prontas para comer!
